return.specificity: Authored for this AAC process: company header band, named repositories (claude-dotfiles, aac-routines), the lander on AAC-AI, Central-time landing window, ready-for-agent and close-as labels in the consequence lines, ticket numbers and blocking chips. Not reusable unchanged by another company.

heuristic_notes.1: Footer progress line, tab counts, save-state line and the Landed line cover the process; no answered-state is visible on a card in these renders, so per-card status is unproven.
heuristic_notes.2: Plain language throughout; 'the lander run on AAC-AI' is the one insider term a reader must already know.
heuristic_notes.3: Skip, change-your-mind, Other and an in-page confirmation exist; a native radio cannot be un-picked, so skipping after a mis-click has no path.
heuristic_notes.4: One accent, one font, identical cards; the 'blocked by' chip is bolder than the other chips and 'Open queue on GitHub' changes position at 768.
heuristic_notes.5: Submit disabled until a pick, Other-without-note hint; GitHub task-list items render as native checkboxes inside the issue panel and invite a click.
heuristic_notes.6: Everything is on the page; 'What I checked before drafting' is styled as a link with no disclosure marker, so its behaviour must be guessed.
heuristic_notes.7: Bulk 'pick every recommended option' and tabs serve the repeat user; keyboard path and focus ring not visible in the captures.
heuristic_notes.8: Clean hierarchy; the how-to paragraph plus three facts delay the first card, and the open issue text on phones doubles card length.
heuristic_notes.9: Change until Landed is stated; what to do after 'Landing failed' is not shown in any render.
heuristic_notes.10: How-to, landing window and queue link present; help sits in the intro rather than beside the field it governs.

personas.name: Jordan
red_flags: 'lander run on AAC-AI' undefined on the page
'What I checked before drafting' reads as a link, not a disclosure
task-list checkboxes in the issue panel look like fields to tick

personas.name: Sam
red_flags: 14 px grey 'Then:' consequence lines and the grey save-state caption are the smallest text at 390 and at 200%
forced colours drop the tinted question band, leaving bold text alone to mark the question
the disabled Submit renders in a colour the forced-colours simulator shows as red

personas.name: Riley
red_flags: a mis-clicked radio cannot be cleared, so 'skip by leaving unpicked' no longer holds
note field is two lines tall for a ruling that replaces the whole answer

strengths: Plain-English explainer beside the raw issue text, with the question in a tinted band and each option carrying its consequence ('Then: ...'), so a ruling can be made without opening GitHub.
State carried by words and weight: Recommended pill, disabled Submit reading 'Nothing to submit yet', progress line; survives forced colours and reduced motion with nothing lost.
No horizontal scroll at 390, tabs become a select, explainer reflows to one column at 200%.

issues.what: Issue text on GitHub is open at 390 px, where the plan says it is collapsed.
issues.why: Each phone card doubles in length and the question sits a full screen below the title.
issues.fix: Wrap the issue panel in details/summary below 600 px, summary 'Issue text on GitHub'.

issues.what: GitHub task-list items render as native unchecked checkboxes inside the read-only issue panel.
issues.why: They look like fields to fill, next to the real radio cards.
issues.fix: Render task items as a glyph or text with aria-hidden on the control; never a form element inside quoted issue text.

issues.what: 'What I checked before drafting' is link-styled with no disclosure marker.
issues.why: A first-time reader cannot tell whether it navigates away or expands.
issues.fix: Use details/summary with the default marker or a 'Show' prefix, keep the accent colour.

issues.what: A picked radio cannot be cleared.
issues.why: 'Skip a card by leaving it unpicked' fails after any mis-click; the only escape is picking Other.
issues.fix: Add a 'Clear pick' text button on an answered card that deletes the saved pick.

issues.what: At 768 'Open queue on GitHub' drops to its own line under the bulk button row.
issues.why: Reads as a stray link rather than part of the repository toolbar.
issues.fix: Flex-wrap the toolbar with a gap, or move the link beside the repository heading.

minor: Offline render shows raw markdown ('## What to build', '- [ ]') in the issue panel: the renderer loads from a CDN. Pre-render issue HTML at build or inline the renderer.
The '#101' ticket number is not visible on the first card at 390; the stitched footer sits over that line, so confirm in a live viewport.
'blocked by #101' chip is heavier than 'holding up #102' and 'needs you'; if intentional, say what the weight means.
The 'Storage unavailable in this view' caption is the only grey text under 16 px in the footer; keep it at the 14 px floor.
